Apple Martini
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, February 10, 2010 - 5:37pm

Ingredients




1 prt vodka (the better the vodka, the better the 1 prt DeKuyper's Apple Pucker
(I use 1 1/2 oz. jigger)
Splash sour mix

Preparation

1 I add a little sugar because I don't like mine so tart 2 Mix over ice in martini shaker. Strain into glass and serve with a cherry
